column3: Close to the Hebrew; “on the surface of the valley” is rendered “in the open valley.”
Close to the Hebrew; “these killed ones” is rendered “these slain.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will act” is rendered “performed it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a piece of wood” is rendered “a stick,” and “take … one” “take another stick.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will give them” is rendered “I will establish them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my dwelling place” is rendered “My tabernacle.”
